title: Construction of a normalized finite-ring smooth orientation
statement: For a finite commutative A killed by a positive N invertible on a Noetherian X, and f:X→Y separated quasi-compact compactifiable and smooth of pure dimension d with Y Noetherian, the actual smooth closed diagonal supplies geometry G and there is an ordinary dualizing-to-line isomorphism alpha satisfying OrientationNormalized.

proof.text: Use the actual closed diagonal geometry. Choose only the uniquely normalized deformation isomorphism kappa. Smooth base change makes the diagonal factor invertible. The Rees-to-symmetric-algebra identification is an isomorphism over X, yielding the required normal-bundle square. The normal-section map and bundle integration adjunct are invertible. Define alpha as the diagonal factor, specialization, inverse normal-section map and inverse integration adjunct. Inverse cancellation proves the exact orientation equation.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1)-(2); explicit Lean construction and square pasting

lean.statement:
theorem generalRingNormalizedOrientation
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] (hX : IsUnit (N : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    ∃ (G : FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d
        (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.diagonal f))
      (alpha : dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ≅ line A N hA X d),
      OrientationNormalized A N hN hA f d G hX alpha
